spell.kubejs.broom.guide: Summons a magic broom after a brief cast.
spell.kubejs.map_travel.guide: After a 5-second cast, opens Xaero World Map and grants one teleport within 60 seconds. Select a waypoint or right-click the map. The destination must be in the current dimension and an already loaded chunk. Failed destinations can be reselected within the remaining time.
spell.kubejs.map_travel.info: One teleport within 60 seconds · Current dimension · Loaded chunks
map_travel.ready: Map Travel ready: one teleport within 60 seconds. Select a waypoint or right-click the map.
map_travel.success: Map Travel successful. Your teleport permit has been consumed.
map_travel.expired: Your Map Travel permit has expired. Cast the spell again.
map_travel.no_permit: No valid Map Travel permit. Cast the spell first.
map_travel.wrong_dimension: Map Travel is limited to the dimension in which the spell was cast.
map_travel.wrong_world: This waypoint or map does not belong to the current world and dimension.
map_travel.unloaded: The destination chunk is not currently loaded. Choose another destination before the permit expires.
map_travel.unsafe: No safe landing space near the destination. Choose another location.
map_travel.invalid_target: Invalid destination. Check the world border and dismount before teleporting.
map_travel.map_missing: Unable to open Xaero World Map. Check that it is installed and initialized.
map_travel.integration_error: Xaero teleport integration failed. See the log for details.
